{"metadata":{"description":"A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) dynamic plugin that cuts token cost without cutting model intelligence","id":"gh:1347955066","install_available":true,"language":"JavaScript","name":"dsh-plugin-save-token","slug":"vibe-any/dsh-plugin-save-token","topics":["agent","dsh-plugin","token-optimization"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness (dsh) dynamic plugin that cuts token cost without cutting model intelligence"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-plugin-save-token"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"English | 简体中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"**In one sentence: a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) dynamic plugin that cuts token cost without cutting mode"},{"id":"p4s2","text":": a DeepSeek Harness (dsh) dynamic plugin that cuts token cost without cutting model intelligence.**"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"> **Codex user?** The same token-optimization brain ships as a standard Codex CLI plugin (MCP stdio "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"server) in `codex-plugin-save-token/` — see its README."},{"id":"p6s1","text":"It slims down oversized tool outputs at the entrance of every model request — **reversibly and struc"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"ture-aware**. The full original text is always saved to disk; what the model sees is always a conden"},{"id":"p6s3","text":"sed version carrying a retrieval path. Every optimization obeys one red line: **any replacement must"},{"id":"p6s4","text":" be restorable in one step**, and the estimated token count after compression must be strictly small"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"er than the original."},{"id":"p7s1","text":"## Why you need it"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"- The bulk of agentic-session cost is **tool output that keeps re-entering the context**: large JSON"},{"id":"p8s2","text":" from APIs, CLI tables, logs. The same 40KB price table may be billed again on every conversation tu"},{"id":"p8s3","text":"rn.
- But blunt truncation degrades intelligence: research shows that even with perfect retrieval, m"},{"id":"p8s4","text":"erely padding the context with irrelevant content drops accuracy by 13.9–85% (curated in "Context Le"},{"id":"p8s5","text":"ngth Alone Hurts"); conversely, over-compression fails too — in production randomized controlled tri"},{"id":"p8s6","text":"als, aggressive compression (keep ratio 0.2) actually made cost **+1.8%** worse, while moderate comp"},{"id":"p8s7","text":"ression (0.5) delivered **−27.9%**.
- Conclusion: **the right way to save tokens is structure-preser"},{"id":"p8s8","text":"ving slimming, not content hacking.** All strategies in this plugin are designed within that boundar"},{"id":"p8s9","text":"ng slimming, not content hacking.** All strategies in this plugin are designed within that boundary."},{"id":"p9s1","text":"## Core optimizations"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"### 1. Structure-aware compression: no more blind table slicing
Detects pipe-delimited high-density "},{"id":"p10s2","text":"table rows (≥70% of lines sharing the same separator profile). When matched, instead of a blind head"},{"id":"p10s3","text":"/tail window it does: keep the first 60 rows verbatim + stride-sample the middle section every N row"},{"id":"p10s4","text":"s with original line numbers annotated (`L61: ...`) + keep the last 40 rows verbatim. The model rece"},{"id":"p10s5","text":"ives a "map with coordinates" — any segment can be fetched precisely by line number.
> Reference: rt"},{"id":"p10s6","text":"k's never-worse guard and error-line retention policy; the stride sampling is this plugin's improvem"},{"id":"p10s7","text":"ent over rtk's head/tail window."},{"id":"p11s1","text":"### 2. TOON-style lossless encoding first
Uniform JSON arrays (e.g. API responses with 300 homogeneo"},{"id":"p11s2","text":"us objects) first go through deterministic tabular re-encoding: `prices[300]{model,input,output}:` —"},{"id":"p11s3","text":" one schema header line + CSV data rows. Keys are written once, zero information loss, and the notic"},{"id":"p11s4","text":"e explicitly says *"zero information loss"*. Lossy paths are only used when the lossless route is un"},{"id":"p11s5","text":"available.
> Reference: TOON — Token-Oriented Object Notation; measured savings of 30–60% tokens on "},{"id":"p11s6","text":"ference: TOON — Token-Oriented Object Notation; measured savings of 30–60% tokens on uniform arrays."},{"id":"p12s1","text":"### 3. Compress means spill (CCR): never burn the bridge
Before every replacement, the original text"},{"id":"p12s2","text":" is written to disk via the dsh `spillStore`; the replacement embeds two retrieval paths: the dynami"},{"id":"p12s3","text":"c tool `save_token_expand` (one-call fetch by marker id) plus a file locator for the original (reada"},{"id":"p12s4","text":"ble directly with read/grep). If spilling fails, compression is abandoned — **reversibility is a har"},{"id":"p12s5","text":"d precondition, not an option**.
> Reference: headroom's CCR (Compress-Cache-Retrieve) pattern."},{"id":"p13s1","text":"### 4. Cross-turn dedup
Tool-call results byte-identical within a 90-second window (rerunning the sa"},{"id":"p13s2","text":"me command, etc.) are replaced by one stub: "This output is identical to N seconds ago, refer to ear"},{"id":"p13s3","text":"lier context." Prevents the same large output from appearing twice in the context.
> Reference: head"},{"id":"p13s4","text":"room's cross-turn dedup."},{"id":"p14s1","text":"### 5. Never-worse double gate
A candidate compressed result is adopted only if it passes both gates"},{"id":"p14s2","text":":
- **Byte gate**: compressed ≤ 72% of the original (`keepRatioMax=0.72`, more conservative than the"},{"id":"p14s3","text":" RCT-validated 0.5), and absolute savings ≥500B;
- **Token gate**: estimated tokens must strictly de"},{"id":"p14s4","text":"crease (an llmtrim-style quality-gating idea).
If either gate fails, the output passes through untou"},{"id":"p14s5","text":"ched.
> Reference: RCT boundary data and quality-gating survey in awesome-llm-token-optimization."},{"id":"p15s1","text":"### 6. Error-line protection
Within the omitted region of log-like output, up to 25 lines matching `"},{"id":"p15s2","text":"error/fatal/traceback/timeout...` are kept (with line-number prefixes). Debugging evidence is never "},{"id":"p15s3","text":"compressed away.
> Reference: rtk's error-line keeps."},{"id":"p16s1","text":"### 7. Compaction pressure coupling
At each reasoning-step boundary, check the session's most recent"},{"id":"p16s2","text":" actual context size; above 120k tokens (10-minute cooldown), fire dsh's native `compaction.compactI"},{"id":"p16s3","text":"fNeeded()` with `'pressure'` and let the engine decide when to summarize history.
> The threshold is"},{"id":"p16s4","text":" a conservative water line (sized for 128k-class context windows); compaction itself is built into d"},{"id":"p16s5","text":"sh — the plugin only hands over the trigger at the right moment."},{"id":"p17s1","text":"### 8. Full-chain metering + dual-panel dashboard
Every `llm/stream` is intercepted: real billed tok"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"ens (input/cached/output/reasoning) and "tokens avoided from context" are accounted separately. Hist"},{"id":"p17s3","text":"orical messages are scanned for `[save-token #id]` markers to total savings (including multi-turn re"},{"id":"p17s4","text":"plays). The Settings page hosts a full panel (KPIs, per-request stacked chart, top-tools leaderboard"},{"id":"p17s5","text":", activity feed), plus a persistent live strip under the input box."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"## Measured results"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"### End-to-end A/B on real agent tasks (2026-08-29)"},{"id":"p20s1","text":"Randomized comparison on GAIA / Terminal-Bench / SWE-bench-Verified tasks — unique variable: the plu"},{"id":"p20s2","text":"gin's compress/dedupe switches; both arms under identical constraints that force large tool output t"},{"id":"p20s3","text":"o be printed directly into the conversation. Full data, scripts and per-episode records: `bench/`, r"},{"id":"p20s4","text":"eport: `bench/report_2026-08-29.md`."},{"id":"p21s1","text":"| Episodes | Success rate | Total tokens | Compressions | Per-episode median |"},{"id":"p22s1","text":"| 24/24 (6 tasks × 2 arms × n=2) | **100% vs 100%** | 5.25M vs **4.32M (−17.6%)** | 16 events across"},{"id":"p22s2","text":" 8/12 episodes | **−56%** |"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"Take-aways: the plugin pays off exactly when large tool output lands directly in
